scripts.build:example: npm --prefix apps/holochain-runtime-example/ui install && npm --prefix apps/holochain-runtime-example/ui run build
scripts.start:example: pnpm run build:example && cargo run -p holochain-runtime-example
scripts.start:example-android: pnpm run build:example && pnpm run --dir apps/holochain-runtime-example start:android
scripts.start:example-ios: pnpm run build:example && pnpm run --dir apps/holochain-runtime-example start:ios
scripts.build:example-android: pnpm run build:example && pnpm run --dir apps/holochain-runtime-example build:android
scripts.build:example-ios: pnpm run build:example && pnpm run --dir apps/holochain-runtime-example build:ios
scripts.test:example: pnpm run build:example && cargo build -p holochain-runtime-example
scripts.test: pnpm run test:runtime && pnpm run test:tauri-plugin-holochain && pnpm run test:example
